ff_specs.Usual Effect: 'Actual' greater than 'Forecast' is good for currency
ff_specs.Frequency: Released monthly, about 29 days after the month ends
ff_specs.FF Notes: Differs from Core CPI in that it only measures goods and services targeted towards and consumed by individuals. CPI is released about 10 days earlier and tends to garner most of the attention
ff_specs.Why Traders Care: It's the Federal Reserve's primary inflation measure. Inflation is important to currency valuation because rising prices lead the central bank to raise interest rates out of respect for their inflation containment mandate
